projects.title: Ocean Space Company Website
projects.description: The company website for Ocean Space, an Indonesian group in phone distribution, retail and lifestyle. Partners can explore its four businesses, job seekers can find open roles, and anyone can contact the team.
projects.description_id: Website resmi Ocean Space, grup usaha Indonesia di bidang distribusi ponsel, retail, dan lifestyle. Partner bisa mengenal keempat unit bisnisnya, pencari kerja bisa melihat lowongan, dan siapa pun bisa menghubungi tim.

projects.title: LMS Legal
projects.description: A web app that keeps a company’s contracts, permits and deeds in one place, shows at a glance what is active, expiring soon or already expired, and sends the person in charge a WhatsApp reminder before anything runs out.
projects.description_id: Web app yang menyimpan kontrak, izin, dan akta perusahaan di satu tempat, menunjukkan mana yang masih aktif, hampir habis, atau sudah kedaluwarsa, lalu mengirim pengingat WhatsApp ke penanggung jawabnya sebelum masa berlakunya habis.

projects.title: Ontime: Selfie Attendance
projects.description: An attendance app for companies. Staff, interns and freelancers check in each morning with a quick selfie, the office sees who is in, on time or late, and the monthly report downloads to Excel in one click.
projects.description_id: Aplikasi absensi untuk perusahaan. Karyawan, anak magang, dan freelancer cukup absen tiap pagi dengan selfie, kantor bisa melihat siapa yang sudah masuk, tepat waktu, atau terlambat, dan laporan bulanan bisa diunduh ke Excel dalam sekali klik.

projects.title: Nouvo AI
projects.description: A calm personal workspace where an AI helper named Simon takes on each task in your projects, and every task keeps its own tab and conversation.
projects.description_id: Workspace pribadi yang tenang, tempat asisten AI bernama Simon mengerjakan setiap tugas di proyekmu, dan setiap tugas punya tab serta percakapannya sendiri.

projects.title: Chisel
projects.description: Chisel lets Roblox creators describe their game idea in plain words, then makes the changes for them right inside Roblox Studio, step by step.
projects.description_id: Chisel membantu kreator Roblox menuliskan ide game mereka dengan bahasa sehari-hari, lalu langsung membuat perubahannya di Roblox Studio, langkah demi langkah.

projects.title: OceanMall Online Store
projects.description: An online gadget and lifestyle store where shoppers in Indonesia browse products, add them to a cart, check out and follow their orders, on the web or on their phone. I contributed to this project as part of the team.
projects.description_id: Toko online gadget dan lifestyle tempat pembeli di Indonesia menjelajah produk, memasukkan ke keranjang, checkout, dan melacak pesanan, baik di web maupun di HP. Saya ikut berkontribusi di proyek ini sebagai bagian dari tim.
